subject.title: Voice-call plugin: hangup aborts in-flight tool calls (sessions_spawn killed before child initializes)

question: Should voice-call hangup abort all in-flight consult tool work, or should sessions_spawn child work decouple once spawn execution has begun or once the child is accepted?
rationale: Current code supports both the reported failure mode and an intentional cancel-on-close interpretation, so changing it safely needs owner intent for voice hangup semantics.

options.title: Define durable accepted-spawn boundary
options.body: Keep voice hangup from killing already accepted independent sessions_spawn children, then require a focused repro to decide whether pre-accept spawn startup also needs shielding.

options.title: Treat hangup as full consult cancel
options.body: Document and preserve current abort semantics so voice-call hangup cancels all in-flight consult tools, including sessions_spawn startup.

options.title: Add plugin grace teardown
options.body: Let voice-call wait briefly for in-flight consult tools during finalizeCall, accepting slower teardown and more plugin-specific lifecycle code.

recommendation.title: Define durable accepted-spawn boundary
recommendation.body: Keep voice hangup from killing already accepted independent sessions_spawn children, then require a focused repro to decide whether pre-accept spawn startup also needs shielding.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checked-out central paths blame to steipete's recent main import, and earlier voice-call cleanup history points there for routing even though sessions_spawn ownership is shared.
